text: 克里斯塔利娜·格奥尔基耶娃（Kristalina Georgieva）抵达阿根廷首都布宜诺斯艾利斯，亲自考察总统哈维尔·米莱的经济复苏成果。目前阿根廷债券价格上涨，通胀下降，央行正在重建现金储备。格奥尔基耶娃对阿根廷最终有望走出反复借贷的恶性循环表示乐观，并认为在2027年总统大选前，阿根廷无需向IMF寻求额外融资。 阿根廷将于9月开始向IMF偿还本金，还款计划将持续至2042年。IMF前官员表示，米莱若想彻底摆脱对IMF的依赖，几乎需要所有环节都万无一失。
text_en: Kristalina Georgieva arrived in Buenos Aires, the capital of Argentina, to personally assess President Javier Milei's economic recovery achievements. Argentine bond prices are currently rising, inflation is declining, and the central bank is rebuilding cash reserves. Georgieva expressed optimism that Argentina may finally break free from the vicious cycle of repeated borrowing and believes no additional IMF financing will be needed before the 2027 presidential election. Argentina will begin repaying principal to the IMF in September, with the repayment plan extending until 2042. A former IMF official said that for Milei to completely escape dependence on the IMF, nearly every factor would need to be flawless.
